name: test_generated_contract_matches_template[daily]
description:
Objective: Daily contract matches the Green Pointe template.
Preconditions: Open Contract templates with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. New application; offer accepted with the case frequency (buyout: MCA debt + buyout same lender/amount).
2. Generate contract and download PDF.
3. Compare with template text.
Expected: Contract text matches the template for the case.
